# opnsense_monit_test (Data Source)

Monit tests (**Services ▸ Monit ▸ Settings ▸ Service Tests Settings**) are reusable conditions that services refer to.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the Monit test.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Action taken when the condition matches.
- `condition` (String) Monit condition, e.g. `cpu usage is greater than 75%`.
- `name` (String) Name of the test.
- `path` (String) Script to run when `action` is `exec`.
- `type` (String) Test type. When unset, OPNsense derives it from `condition` (e.g. `cpu usage …` becomes `SystemResource`); a value that contradicts the condition is replaced by OPNsense.
